purpose: Route natural-language skill-building requests to the best Skill Master advisor skill.

routingPolicy.primaryRule: Choose the most specific category that owns the durable workflow, expected artifact, and highest-risk behavior.
routingPolicy.businessRule: For business work, prefer role-specific categories before cross-functional business operations.
routingPolicy.stateChangingRule: Add security and compliance as an adjacent category for regulated, permissioned, destructive, or sensitive workflows.

categories.label: Skill governance
categories.routeWhen: The human wants to author, audit, review, migrate, publish, or govern skills themselves.
exampleRequests: Review all skills and tell me which are ready.
Help me design a checklist for portable SKILL.md files.
Create standards for skill descriptions and validation.
forwardTestPrompts: /skill-master Review all skills and tell me which are ready.
/skill-master Build a React UI.

categories.label: Software engineering
categories.routeWhen: The target skill helps agents inspect, edit, test, review, refactor, migrate, or explain codebases.
exampleRequests: Make a skill for reviewing pull requests in TypeScript repos.
I need a skill that migrates old Express routes to Fastify.
Design a debugging skill for CLI tools.
negativeExamples: Design a UI layout skill without codebase workflows.
forwardTestPrompts: /skill-master Make a skill for reviewing pull requests in TypeScript repos.
/skill-master Design a UI layout skill without codebase workflows.

categories.label: Frontend design
categories.routeWhen: The target skill helps agents build or improve frontend UI, UX, visual implementation, responsive layouts, or design-system usage.
exampleRequests: Create a skill for building polished SaaS dashboards.
Help me design a responsive layout repair skill.
Make a skill that enforces our design system in React.
negativeExamples: Review a Figma file as a design critique without implementation.
forwardTestPrompts: /skill-master Create a skill for building polished SaaS dashboards.
/skill-master Review a Figma file as a design critique without implementation.

categories.label: Testing and QA
categories.routeWhen: The target skill designs repeatable quality checks, test automation, browser verification, accessibility checks, or regression workflows.
exampleRequests: Design a Playwright visual regression skill.
Make a skill for triaging failing CI tests.
Create an accessibility audit skill for web apps.
negativeExamples: Use a browser to operate a third-party site.
forwardTestPrompts: /skill-master Design a Playwright visual regression skill.
/skill-master Use a browser to operate a third-party site.

categories.label: Documents and office

exampleRequests: Make a skill for extracting terms from PDFs.

negativeExamples: Review contract risk without file-format handling.
forwardTestPrompts: /skill-master Make a skill for extracting terms from PDFs.
/skill-master Analyze SQL warehouse data.
